description: Old brand names kept on purpose (rebrand-rules.md §5, legacy-name markers). The grep gate (scripts/legacy-brand.mjs, run by scripts/legacy-brand.test.mjs and the commercial core's tests/legacy-brand.test.ts) allows only these.
format: A hit of /gateway|wiolett/i or a gw*_ token prefix passes when its file matches excludedPaths, the hit lies inside a match of a genericPhrases regex, it is on or directly under a `legacy-name:` marker comment (the marker's comment block and the statement under it), or the file matches one of an entry's paths (globs: ** spans directories, * one segment, {a,b}; a commercial: prefix names a path in the commercial core) and the hit lies inside a match of the entry's pattern (a JavaScript regular expression, case-sensitive unless flags has i). File paths are checked too.
